description: ΑΡΧΕΙΟ ΓΕΩΓΡΑΦΙΚΗΣ ΑΠΟΔΟΣΗΣ ΑΓΩΓΩΝ ΟΜΒΡΙΩΝ ΒΑΡΗΣ-ΒΟΥΛΑΣ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΙΩΑΝΝΗΣ ΠΑΛΑΜΙΔΑΣ. Coverage: ΙΩΑΝΝΗΣ ΠΑΛΑΜΙΔΑΣ. The portal shows the English title as "GEOGRAFIČKA RAZMJENA OMVRIOS VARIS-VOULASA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΙΩΑΝΝΗΣ ΠΑΛΑΜΙΔΑΣ. Its keywords include Γεωχωρικά δεδομένα, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2 download or service links in RAR. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
